up: Retrieve all compounds with IC50 activity values measured in nanomolars (nM) against the human target 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic'. For each activity record, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key (from the compound records), and the publication identifier (prefer PubMed ID, fallback to DOI). Also include relevant assay metadata (such as assay description or assay type) and target metadata (target name, organism). Ensure the query joins activities with assays, target dictionary, molecule dictionary, compound structures, compound records, and docs to gather all requested provenance and structural details.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE td.pref_name = 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
